description:
What You'll Be Promoting

Partner with Venneir® to promote our complete range of premium cosmetic dental and oral care products, all manufactured in-house at our GDC-registered UK dental lab in BioCity, Scotland.

💎 Custom-Fit Dental Appliances (High-Ticket Items)

All custom appliances are made-to-order in our state-of-the-art laboratory using precise dental impressions or digital scans.

  • Click-In Veneers (up to £399) – Our flagship product. Custom-fit, removable veneer shells that instantly transform smiles, restore gaps, and replace missing teeth for a seamless aesthetic solution.
  • Essix Retainers (1.0mm or 1.5mm Hard PETG) – Crystal-clear retention for post-orthodontic patients.
  • Scalloped Essix Retainers – Gum-line scalloped design for enhanced comfort.
  • Retainer with Missing Tooth (replaces up to 4 teeth) – Functional retention with aesthetic tooth replacement.
  • Professional Whitening Trays (1.5mm Semi-hard EVA) – Custom-fit trays for at-home professional whitening.
  • Night Guards (3.0mm Soft EVA) – Premium protection against nighttime teeth grinding and clenching.
  • Day Guards (2.0mm Slimline EVA) – Discreet daytime bruxism protection that's comfortable to wear during work or daily activities.

🦷 Professional Oral Care Products

Specially formulated for people with cosmetic dental work: veneers, bonding, crowns, and implants.

  • Venneir Non-Abrasive Toothpaste – Fluoride-based, enamel-safe formula that's SLS-free and stain-removing. Safe for veneers, bonding, implants, crowns, and natural teeth. Natural peppermint flavour.
  • Venneir Anti-Stain Mouthwash – Fluoride-free, alcohol-free formula that prevents discolouration on dental work. Enriched with aloe vera and vitamin E. Crystal clear and peppermint flavoured.
  • Medical-Grade Tongue Scrapers – Stainless steel construction for superior oral hygiene.
  • Dental Flossing Tape with Mirror – Premium flossing solution with integrated inspection mirror.
  • Retainer & Guard Storage Cases – Protective travel cases for dental appliances.

✨ Teeth Whitening & Aesthetic Solutions

  • Professional Whitening Gel Syringes – High-quality whitening formula for use with custom trays.
  • Complete Whitening Kits – All-in-one solution including custom trays and professional-grade gel.
  • LED Whitening Light – Phone-powered LED accelerator for enhanced whitening results.

💰 Your Earning Potential

Commission Rate: 7.5% on all products

Earn on every sale, from £15 oral care products to our £399 custom veneers. With high-value items in our range, your earning potential is substantial.

Example Earnings:

  • Click-In Veneers (£399) = Up to £29.93 per sale
  • Essix Retainers (£99) = £7.43 per sale
  • Night Guards (£149) = £11.18 per sale
  • Whitening Kits (£79) = £5.93 per sale

🎯 Marketing Support & Tools

We provide everything you need to succeed as a Venneir affiliate:

  • Affiliate Dashboard: Real-time tracking of clicks, conversions, and earnings with detailed analytics.
  • Professional Creative Assets: High-resolution product photography, promotional banners, email templates, and social media content ready to use.
  • Custom QR Codes: Available on request for offline promotions, business cards, and printed materials.
  • Exclusive Discount Codes: Special promotional codes and seasonal campaigns designed for your audience.
  • Educational Content: Product guides, comparison charts, and FAQs to help you educate your audience.
  • Dedicated Support: Need custom marketing materials? Just ask. We'll create what you need.

🌟 Partner Benefits

  • Reliable Monthly Payouts: Payments sent on the 5th of each month directly to your PayPal account. Minimum threshold £20, no delays.
  • 30-Day Cookie Tracking: Earn commissions on purchases made up to 30 days after someone clicks your link.
  • Early Access: Be the first to know about new product launches, exclusive promotions, and beta testing opportunities.
  • Co-Branding Opportunities: Collaborate with us on joint campaigns, guest blog features on venneir.com, social media takeovers, and educational webinars.
  • Performance Bonuses: Top-performing affiliates receive special incentives, increased commission rates, and exclusive partnership opportunities.
  • No Sales Quotas: Promote at your own pace, there's no pressure or minimum sales requirements.

Ready to Start Earning?

Join hundreds of affiliates already earning with Venneir. Sign up today and get instant access to your dashboard, marketing materials, and unique affiliate link.

Questions? Contact us at cs@venneir.com
payout_period: Commissions are paid monthly on the 5th via PayPal once you reach the £20 minimum threshold. All earnings from the previous month are processed automatically.
